name: Bambu Lab
description: Bambu Lab printer driver via bambulabs_api. Supports AMS, RFID and automatic filament matching. Uses a readonly-safe assignment flow: printer write commands are not sent, while slot reading, tracking, and FilaMan spool location assignment continue.
author: Dox base on FilaMan Original Plugin

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: Select your Bambu Lab printer model. Determines AMS data structure handling.

host.title: IP/Hostname
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Bambu printer

reconnect_interval_minutes.title: Reconnect Interval (Minutes)
reconnect_interval_minutes.description: Interval in minutes between reconnection attempts on connection loss

auto_unassign_on_remove.title: Auto Unassign On Removal
auto_unassign_on_remove.description: Automatically clear FilaMan slot assignment when a spool is removed from this printer slot

enable_consumption_tracking.title: Enable Consumption Tracking
enable_consumption_tracking.description: Track print consumption and write spool consumption events during print end

local_3mf_timeout_seconds.title: Local 3MF Fetch Timeout (Seconds)
local_3mf_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for local FTPS 3MF metadata fetch used by print weight estimation

local_3mf_ftps_verify_tls.title: Verify FTPS Certificate
local_3mf_ftps_verify_tls.description: Validate printer FTPS TLS certificate for local 3MF fetch. Disable to auto-accept self-signed certificates.

resolve_shop_images.title: Catalog Images (Bambu Lab)
resolve_shop_images.description: Enable catalog metadata enrichment for slot payloads. Image URLs are only set when present in printer payloads or resolvable via template.

shop_image_url_template.title: Shop Image URL Template
shop_image_url_template.description: Optional URL template used when resolve_shop_images is enabled. Use {code} for material code and {name} for material name.
